Name: Astropy
Description: Community core Python library for astronomy and astrophysics, covering coordinates, time, units, tables, FITS, WCS, and common analysis utilities.

Name: healpy
Description: Python package for handling HEALPix pixelated maps on the sphere, used for CMB and all-sky astrophysics analysis.

Name: Photutils
Description: Astropy coordinated package for source detection and photometry on astronomical imagery, including aperture and PSF photometry, segmentation, and background estimation.

Name: CAMB
Description: Code for Anisotropies in the Microwave Background; computes CMB, lensing, matter power spectra, transfer functions, and background cosmology.

Name: PySM
Description: Python Sky Model package for full-sky simulations of Galactic emission and polarization relevant to CMB experiments.

Name: MontePython
Description: Monte Carlo Markov Chain code for cosmological parameter inference, with likelihood tooling and CLASS integration.

Name: SWIFT
Description: Modern astrophysics and cosmology particle-based simulation code for gravity, hydrodynamics, and large-scale simulations.

Name: RAMSES
Description: Adaptive mesh refinement code for astrophysical systems, self-gravity, magnetised fluid flows, radiation, and cosmological simulations.

Name: Mulview
Description: Multi-view FITS cube visualization workflow in Takefits for synchronized XY, XZ, and ZY views of radio astronomy data.
